templates.title: DarkMoon (open source CLI)
templates.description: Open source (GPL-3.0) autonomous AI penetration testing toolbox. An LLM orchestrates specialist agents and offensive tools over MCP, can run on a local model, and proves each finding with a real exploit. This is the terminal-driven (TUI) open source engine, not the DarkMoon Pro web dashboard: after deploy, open the console of the 'opencode' container to drive it.
templates.note: PRIVILEGED STACK — deploy only on a host you control. It mounts /var/run/docker.sock into both containers (root-equivalent host control), runs the scanner with network_mode host and NET_RAW/NET_ADMIN capabilities (for LAN scanning; Chrome DevTools port 9222 is exposed on the host), and runs as root. It needs an LLM: this template is preset for a cloud provider (fill provider, model and API key below); for a local model (Ollama, llama.cpp) or an on-prem Anthropic-compatible endpoint, edit the stack environment after deploy. OSS/Pro note: the web dashboard and the remediation-to-PR agent are DarkMoon Pro and are NOT part of this open source stack. Docs: https://github.com/ASCIT31/darkmoon-cloud-deploy/blob/master/docs/portainer.md

env.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER
env.label: LLM provider
env.description: Cloud provider name, e.g. anthropic, openai or openrouter.

env.name: OPENCODE_MODEL
env.label: Model name
env.description: Model to use, e.g. claude-opus-4-6, gpt-4o, or any OpenRouter model id.

env.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env.label: API key
env.description: API key for the chosen provider. Kept in the stack; never inline it in a public place.
